data.name: Azariel
data.gender_notes: Azariel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Azariel is derived from the Hebrew language. It is composed of two elements: 'azar' which means 'helper' and 'el' which means 'God'. Thus, Azariel can be interpreted as 'Helper of God' or 'God's Helper'. The name Azariel carries the meaning “Helper of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Azariel usually hope their child will grow to embody helper of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Azariel is a name that carries a deep spiritual significance. It is believed to represent the divine helper, an angelic being sent by God to assist and protect humanity. In Christian tradition, Azariel is the name of the angel who shows the child Jesus to Mary after his birth. It is a name that reminds us of the presence and power of God in our lives.
data.etymology: Azariel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azariel total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
